carousel.ariaLabel: What you can do with DayDan

problem.title: Stop forgetting the little things
problem.body: DayDan remembers the last time it happened, and when it's due next. So nobody else has to.

capture.title: Add it before you forget it
capture.body: Type it, say it out loud, or snap a photo. DayDan fills in the due date, priority, labels, and who's on it.

circle.title: Everyone gets a turn, No more arguing
circle.body: Rotate in the order you pick, or at random. DayDan remembers who went last, so turns stay fair.

reminders.title: A nudge right when it matters & Widgets!
reminders.body: Get a reminder before something's due, or send  a heads-up when someone forgets theirs. Today's list sits on your home screen too.

capture.voiceCaption: Dates, labels and points from your words

privacy.title: Help us improve DayDan

crashReports.label: Share crash reports
crashReports.description: When DayDan crashes, send us the error and what led to it (device, app version, the screen you were on) no task content. It's how we catch bugs that never show up in our own testing and ship fixes faster.

analytics.label: Share anonymous usage analytics
analytics.description: Send anonymous usage events which features get used, which get ignored so we know what to build next instead of guessing. No task content, no personal data, nothing tied back to you.
